name: DeleteWithConfirmation
title: Templates/Platform/Overlays/DeleteWithConfirmation
summary: The destructive confirmation a resource list uses for Delete: a warning `Alert`, a sentence naming what goes with the resource and a Help Center link, then a prompt that shows the resource name as a click-to-copy chip and an input the user must match before Delete enables. Every resource list, a folder of files and a table of records open it from the row Delete action; the title reads Delete plus the resource kind, and a container that holds other items passes its own consequence sentence. The typed confirmation and the Copied reveal reset each time the dialog opens, so the content stays put while it closes. Built from `ConfirmDialog` (the body in its default slot, Cancel and Delete in its `actions` slot), `Alert`, `Tooltip`, `Input` and `Button`; closed by default behind a visible danger trigger.
